name: Kodiyal Restaurant Sharjah Al Nahda
address: Al wazir building Nahda - behind KFC - Hay Al Nahda - Sharjah - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Serving Authentic Managorean food. We serve Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

reviews.author: shammas abdul shukkoor
reviews.text:
Tried fish thali at Kodiyal Restaurant and really enjoyed it. The food had an authentic Mangalorean seafood taste, and thali came with a decent sized fish fry along with some sides. Everything tasted fresh and well prepared.

The service was good, and the ambience was pleasant and comfortable. Overall, a great place to enjoy a proper Mangalorean style seafood meal. Definitely worth trying if you enjoy authentic coastal / Mangalorean flavours!

reviews.author: Satya M Shetty
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely loved our experience at Kodiyal Restaurant! ❤️ The Mangalorean food was superb, authentic, and full of flavour—truly satisfying for anyone who loves Mangalorean cuisine.

And a special mention to the waiter, who was exceptionally friendly, attentive, and helpful. His excellent service made our dining experience even more enjoyable. 👏

Amazing food + outstanding service = a perfect experience!
Highly recommended! ❤️🙏

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Fiona Peters
reviews.text: Amazing food! It truly felt like home. The staff were very friendly, and the owner was warm and welcoming. We ordered the Crab Ghee Roast, Prawns Masala, and Prawns Mango Curry, and every dish was absolutely delicious. The flavors were authentic, fresh, and perfectly cooked. It was a complete foodgasm! 😍 Definitely one of the best Mangalorean food experiences. Highly recommended, and I'll definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Hnin Thiri
reviews.text: Delicious biryani with rich flavors and generous portions. My husband absolutely loved the food.The food was fresh, tasty, and satisfying. Friendly service and a comfortable dining atmosphere. Will definitely visit again!

reviews.author: Cherry Plenos
reviews.text:
Amazing Biryani in Al Nahda
Our Filipino family tried the chicken and mutton biryani and it was fantastic! The flavors are just like the fancy spots in town, but at great prices.

Highly recommend it for anyone craving biryani!

reviews.author: Darshan
reviews.text: Tried this place while passing by Sharjah. Authentic Mangalorean food, Delicious Meals and fish. Staff and owner and very friendly. Must try . Will definitely visit again

reviews.author: Sowmya A
reviews.text: Must-try authentic Mangalorean food at a good price! The ambience is nice and clean, and the staff are very kind and welcoming. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Errol Clement Dsouza
reviews.text: One of the best mangalorean food that we had. Must visit restaurant in Sharjah. Enjoy their food. Very friendly staff and manager. They will ask for food feedback at the same time. If staying in Sharjah or in dubai please visit this place. Very cooperative. Good Mangalorean food options both multiple options for food. Thank you.

reviews.author: Amrita Mukherjee
reviews.text: We visited Kodiyal Restaurant and tried the Mysore Masala dosa—it was okay but not particularly outstanding. The staffs were polite and courteous, and the ambience was satisfactory. Overall, it was an average experience.

reviews.author: Tinu Thomas
reviews.text: Mangalapuram meals tried nice also fish fry? Thank you team for the wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Rohit Anand
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at this restaurant today the staff is very homely and courteous. The food was outstanding. I would recommend at this restaurant to anybody who would like to try Mandalorian food.

reviews.author: prashanth 2009
reviews.text:
🙏🏼 Thank you, Kodiyal Restaurant, Sharjah! 🙏🏼

We had a family lunch function at home and initially ordered lunch for around 15 people. But the food was so delicious that we ended up serving around 22–23 people! 😍

The Mangalorean local food had around 13–15 different items, and every dish was absolutely amazing. The taste reminded us of a function back home in our hometown. ❤️

All our family and friends who came to our home really loved the food and appreciated the taste. There was absolutely no compromise on taste or quality.

Thank you so much, Kodiyal Restaurant, Sharjah, for making our family function even more special. 🙏🏼❤️

Thumba ishta aayithu namagellargu! 😍
Highly recommended for authentic Mangalorean food! 👌🏼

reviews.author: Lancy Pinto
reviews.text: Finally we have an authenic Mangalorean restaurant in Sharjah. We tried this restaurant upon suggestion by one of our friends.  The food was amazing and also the service. You feel like you are eating the home cooked meal. Their biriyani reminded me of Mangalorean flavours. The fish thali is simply amazing. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone missing Mangalorean food

reviews.author: Sanjeev Vasudevan
reviews.text: First time visit on 11.01.26. For having breakfast with family. Had ordered Goli Bhaji, Mangalore Buns, Kesari Bath and Ghee Dosa. The food taste was very good. The service was very quick. Will go there again to try their non-veg dishes for lunch or dinner. Overall very satisfying. My office colleagues had recommended this place as they were from mangalore.

reviews.author: Avi Official
reviews.text: Tasty Mangalorean food! Tried the Chicken Kabab, Prawns Ghee Roast, Maanji Tawa Fry, Chicken Sukka , Neer Dosa, and Pundi — all were delicious. Will definitely revisit the restaurant to try more dishes. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Sasha Monteiro
reviews.text: Awesome food! Their breakfast is great, and if you love authentic Mangalorean coastal food, their ghee roast and fresh seafood are a must-try. Totally worth it, easily one of the best spots in Sharjah.

reviews.author: MOHAMED SHAMEER MOOSAKHAN
reviews.text: One of the best of not the best mangalorean restaurants in Dubai and Sharjah… visited them for a late lunch they graciously accepted us. Staffs are friendly… food awesome… I had also visited their Dubai branch for breakfast… both Dubai and Sharjah branch food is amazing and good quality… all mangaloreans and all good food lovers must visit them… Dubai branch has slightly better interiors and more spacious..

reviews.author: Thilakraj Konchadi
reviews.text: We visited Kodiyal Restaurant for lunch and had a wonderful experience. The hospitality was excellent, and the staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive throughout our visit. What truly stood out was the authentic Mangalorean food served here. Every dish reflected traditional flavors and tasted just like home-cooked food. The quality, taste, and authenticity of the cuisine made our dining experience memorable. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy genuine Mangalorean delicacies in Sharjah.

reviews.author: Calvin Rebello
reviews.text: Gave 3 star rating as I just went to this place with my family yesterday and while the ambience was good we requested for non-spicy chicken noodles for my 2yr old daughter and all the dishes for my dad which was green masala mutton curry and tawa fish fry to be non-spicy as they cannot handle spicy food. The waiter assured us of this but gave us super spicy food. We even ordered kori roti which we told less spice but that was also extremely spicy. We ordered also the Ghee roast which was super firey spicy but flavorful. Not too happy that our request was not considered but food was decent which is why I gave 3 stars.

reviews.author: Alphonse D'souza
reviews.text: Tasty homely Mangalorean food. Friendly staff. Had delicious Chicken ghee roast (truly awesome!), fish thali (highly recommended).. cooling “kokam drink” for the summer! All in all, a great dining experience.

reviews.author: Rezekiev Rego
reviews.text:
Amazing manglorean food, good and cozy place. Must visit!!
Best item is angel fish and their Khori roti set..
Rohit was the best host at the restaurant..

reviews.author: Walter
reviews.text:
Best Mangalorean food in Sharjah – just 10 minutes from Dubai!

Kodiyal Restaurant in Al Nahda, Sharjah is hands down the best place for authentic Mangalorean cuisine. The flavors are rich, traditional, and taste just like home. From the perfectly spiced chicken ghee roast to the neer dosa and seafood curries, every dish is fresh and full of authentic coastal flavor.

The service is warm and friendly, and the staff is always helpful with recommendations. Portions are generous and prices are very reasonable for the quality you get. If you’re craving true Mangalorean food, this place is a must-visit. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Mishal Dsouza
reviews.text: Hands down the best mangalorean food in Sharjah. We took fish thali and king fish tawa fry. The fish was one of the best ever had in UAE. Prices are reasonable and food is worth.

reviews.author: Supriya Shetty
reviews.text: We had lunch here at Kodiyal restaurant, food quality was really good and authentic manglorean  taste you will get. Very fast service and hygiene 👌🏻if you want Mangalore taste must visit and enjoy. Staff are very friendly. Will visit again and again.

reviews.author: Sandy King
reviews.text: I ordered chicken biryani from this restaurant for the first time today. The experience was very disappointing. The taste was very very bad, the chicken was not cooked properly, and even the raita seemed spoiled. I definitely won’t recommend this restaurant to anyone.

reviews.author: Premila Vas
reviews.text:
Awesome food! Their marvai pundi was more delicious than what I ate in Mangalore! 🥳🥳marwai was very fresh, curry had authentic taste, totally enjoyed.  Neeru dose  was just perfect. Chicken koliwada had mouthwatering taste so were the squids .  Service was quick.
I enjoyed every bit of my experience at Kodiyal Restaurant . Will be visiting soon this weekend.
If you are looking for authentic Mangalorean delicacies with taste and freshness, do visit Kodiyal Resturant!
Highly recommended 🤩

reviews.author: Sameer Sheikh
reviews.text: A perfect destination for authentic Mangalore food. If you’re craving the true flavors of Mangalore, don’t miss this place. Amazing food, friendly service, and affordable prices make it absolutely worth visiting.

reviews.author: Elston D'cruz
reviews.text:
They were good when they started.
We were regular customers & we have suggested so many people to visit here as initially their food was good.
But right now they are not accepting Zomato pay, even when they are listed on Zomato.

reviews.author: Umama Saiad
reviews.text:
If you’re craving authentic coastal flavors, Kodiyal Restaurant is definitely worth a visit!
The prawns curry is an absolute must-try—rich, flavorful, and perfectly spiced. The fish rawa fry is just as amazing, crispy on the outside and tender inside. Every bite really took me back to my home country.
Don’t miss the lime soda—it’s incredibly refreshing and pairs perfectly with the meal.
Overall, a fantastic experience with very nice food. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy delicious seafood!

reviews.author: sinan CNan
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant. The food was delicious with a great variety to choose from, and the breakfast was excellent. The service was impressively quick, and the staff was very attentive. It is a very family-friendly atmosphere, and we felt completely comfortable dining here with our infant
